system.description:
You weave Hand Seals as you select one point you can see within range. The point you choose erupts with 4 different 5 feet wide, 30-foot-long beams of Fire, that shoots in different directions that all originate from the point you chose. No beam can Fire in the same direction.

All creatures who are in the range of any beam fired must make a dexterity saving throw taking 8d6+8 Fire damage and gaining 3 ranks of Burned on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

Combination: Increase the damage dealt by 1d6+1 and the number of beams by +1, for every additional creature aiding in casting this jutsu, beyond the first two.
